title: Food + beverage campaign: shared robots, corridor and coffee cell
note: FD02 + FD07 + BV01 + BV03 share resources inside one workload (verification.md section 4). Entries name runner scenarios of the source registry; `requires` equals the runtime preflight for that scenario (the FD02 verification row also owns FD02-cups, which needs the cell). BV01 uses the pinned sil/bv01.json fixture and the server native-config; a simulation run needs the exact required backend set and never falls back. The concurrent mixed workload remains explicitly unsupported by the native runner.
